text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev-2 — billing emitter window slip detected. Token emit vs ingest drift ~18% across recent windows. ~120 customers triggered overage flags. Paging @oncall.

morgan: grabbing context, oncall here. linking logs and dashboards.

jamal: taking lead for now, joining. what region + emitter build?

morgan: saw rollout emitter-v2 -> canary at 2026-03-17T03:10Z. CA region first.

jamal: ok. first quick check — run per-window emit vs ingest counts.

jamal: ```sql
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens_emitted) AS emitted, sum(tokens_ingested) AS ingested,
  (sum(tokens_emitted)-sum(tokens_ingested))/nullif(sum(tokens_ingested),0) AS drift
FROM billing.emitter_agg
WHERE window_start >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 12;
```

oncall-shadow: I can confirm drift lines up starting ~03:12Z, consistent with emitter-v2 canary traffic ramp. KV-ttl on aggregation cache shows reordering spikes.

priya: finance-ops here — we're getting customer overage emails. Can we pause automated overage notifications ASAP? Customers are already replying.

finance-ops: pausing auto-notifications now. running /scripts/pause_overage_notifications.sh --source billing --reason "emit-drift"

morgan: running pause...

morgan: ```bash
$ /scripts/pause_overage_notifications.sh --source billing --reason emit-drift
> notifications paused for billing overage alerts (id: pause-5295)
```

jamal: mitigation plan: 1) pause notifications (done), 2) revert emitter-v2 on canary, 3) start backfill to reconcile windows, 4) tag affected customers for refund/credit, 5) customer comms draft.

oncall-shadow: observed root cause signal: emitter-v2 changes to window flush ordering + kafka partitioning + kv-ttl leads to windows shipping tokens to later buckets. That creates an apparent emit surplus in earlier windows.

morgan: initiating revert of emitter-v2 on Canary group A. Command: ```deployctl rollback emitter-service --to release/v1 --canary A```

jamal: revert started. rolling back canary A -> v1 (will monitor for any further drift).

morgan: rollback completed at 03:28Z. metrics: drift dropping on subsequent windows but backfill needed for affected windows between 03:10-03:28Z.

jamal: starting backfill job now: ```bash
$ jobs/run_backfill.sh --service billing --from 2026-03-17T03:10Z --to 2026-03-17T03:28Z --priority high
Backfill job id: backfill-5295-01
```

priya: drafting customer comms and refund note. putting a short notice out: "We saw incorrect overage notifications due to a transient billing emitter issue; interventions are complete and we are issuing credits where applicable. Full update forthcoming." Link to draft: https://go/comm-drafts/5295 (internal).

finance-ops: early impact estimate: ~120 customers flagged, gross delta ~3% of daily billable tokens for affected customers. We'll queue credits once backfill completes.

jamal: assigning owners: postmortem owner = jamal, remediation owner = morgan (fix emitter ordering + tests), customer comms = priya, finance reconciliation = finance-ops. Next status update in 15m or when backfill completes.

incident-bot: Status update: alerts paused, emitter-v2 canary reverted, backfill job backfill-5295-01 started. Monitoring ingestion vs emit aggregates.

morgan: watching dashboards; drift trending down. keeping monitoring until backfill finishes.

jamal: leaving this as active incident handoff to SRE. @sre-lead can you monitor and escalate to eng-runtime if drift reappears?

sre-lead: Ack. I'll watch the token-emit vs ingest dashboard and set alert threshold stricter for next 6 hours. Creating incident tracker INC-2026-345 and linking this thread.

priya: once backfill done, I'll run comms send and coordinate credit memos with finance-ops.

finance-ops: noted, preparing reconciliation sheet.

jamal: thanks team. I'll update on final impact once backfill complete and soft-close the pager after verification.

incident-bot: Next update scheduled +10m."
